findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: review_code, review_code_closer, seo_audit, paid_review, paid_answer, paid_fix, paid_translate, paid_digest, paid_appraise, paid_image, paid_backtest, paid_arbitrage · Public sink: seo_audit, skill_health, skill_discovery, paid_review, paid_answer, paid_fix, paid_translate, paid_digest, paid_appraise, paid_image, paid_backtest, paid_arbitrage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: review_code, review_code_closer, seo_audit, paid_review, paid_answer, paid_fix, paid_translate, paid_digest, paid_appraise, paid_image, paid_backtest, paid_arbitrage · Public sink: seo_audit, skill_health, skill_discovery, paid_review, paid_answer, paid_fix, paid_translate, paid_digest, paid_appraise, paid_image, paid_backtest, paid_arbitrage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
